mapper.update: UPDATE ${table.sqlName} SET directory_context_id=#{row.directoryContextId},owner_id=#{row.ownerId},state=#{row.state},payload=#{row.payload},content_hash=#{row.contentHash}, parent_id=#{row.parentId},session_id=#{row.sessionId},unique_key=#{row.uniqueKey}, runner_id=#{row.runnerId},fencing_token=#{row.fencingToken},sequence_number=#{row.sequenceNumber}, expires_at=#{row.expiresAt},updated_at=#{row.updatedAt},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{row.id} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pc_event WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND sequence_number > #{cursor} AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY sequence_number LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM pc_message WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND sequence_number <= #{end} AND state!='REVOKED_IMPORT' ORDER BY sequence_number DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pc_message WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND state!='REVOKED_IMPORT'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0) FROM ${table.sqlName} WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND state!='REVOKED_IMPORT'
SELECT * FROM ${table.sqlName} WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND id > #{after} AND id <= #{end} AND state!='REVOKED_IMPORT' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ${table.sqlName} WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND state!='REVOKED_IMPORT' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(MIN(sequence_number),0) FROM pc_event WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND expires_at > #{now}
SELECT * FROM pc_task_lease WHERE state='ACTIVE' AND expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT t.* FROM pc_task t WHERE t.state='ENQUEUED' AND t.runner_id=#{runnerId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pc_runner r WHERE r.id=#{runnerId} AND r.owner_id=t.owner_id) ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 100
SELECT w.* FROM pc_directory_context w WHERE w.state='VERIFIED' AND w.owner_id=#{userId} ORDER BY w.id DESC
